arms.description: Low-fear preparedness message with a positive protective example

outcome_question: How likely is it that you will put together a home emergency kit with food, water, and other items?
decision_maker: an emergency-preparedness communicator choosing among three fielded public messages
utility_rationale: Higher normalized utility means greater readiness to assemble a home emergency kit, including already having one. The task measures preparedness intention, not broader counterterrorism policy welfare.
truthfulness_scope: The three messages are benchmarked as historically fielded communication policies. Any present-day deployment would require a separate factual and safety review.
target_population: unweighted released SocSci210 analytic sample from the Knowledge Networks general-population panel
reconstruction_note: SocSci210 condition 0 maps to the source plain low-fear message, condition 1 to high fear, and condition 2 to low-fear positive protection. Released treatment strings are truncated, so the blinded bundle transcribes the final fielded questionnaire. No response value was used to construct this contract.
